This [[Yuuzhan Vong]] '''warrior''' was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]] during the latter years of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> he was the youngest member of a group of Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] that pursued [[Estoric Sandskimmer]] and [[Hohass Ekwesh]], members of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], as they escaped from a [[Shaper caste|shapers']] compound on the planet with a [[Mission to Chashima|stolen]] [[commbuzzer]], a bioweapon that the Yuuzhan Vong planned to use against the Galactic Alliance. The warriors threw [[Nang hul|thud bugs]] at the fleeing Wraiths, striking Sandskimmer and causing him to fall to the ground and drop the bioweapon, allowing the warriors to catch up to them. As Ekwesh stood his ground with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] to protect his injured companion, the [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong leader (Chashima)|leader]] of the warriors directed the youngest warrior and [[Unidentified Yuuzhan Vong warrior (Voort saBinring victim)|another]] to fight the Wraiths as a training exercise.<ref name="MK" />

The youngest warrior charged the defenseless Sandskimmer while Ekwesh threw a cloud of [[Unidentified glittering dust|glittering dust]] that temporarily blinded him. Despite losing his sight, the warrior still managed to impale Sandskimmer through the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] with his [[amphistaff]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. Ekwesh then slammed into the blinded warrior and repeatedly stabbed him with his [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]], killing him in retaliation.<ref name="MK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yuuzhan Vong warrior  was created by [[Aaron Allston]] for his [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', the tenth volume in the  [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series.<ref name="MK" />
